reasoning_content: My pkill matched my own shell command (the command string contained the pattern "webpack"), and killed my own shell (exit 143). The static python server on 8081 is gone (8081 is not in the port list), but the webpack dev server (pid 1554, 1555) is still running. Let's kill it by specifying the exact PID.

action.command: kill 1554 1555 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; ps -p 1554 -p 1555 2>/dev/null; echo "---remaining node procs---"; ps aux | grep -E 'webpack|http.server' | grep -v grep; echo "---listening ports---"; for f in /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do [ -f "$f" ] && awk 'NR>1 && $4=="0A" {split($2,a,":"); printf "%d\n", ("0x" a[2])+0}' "$f"; done | sort -un; echo "cleanup done"
